**[[Botswana]] [[President of Botswana|president]] [[Duma Boko]] announces the launch of a [[Immigrant investor programs|immigrant investor program]] aimed at raising funds to [[Diversification (finance)|diversify]] the economy amid a [[recession]] in the global [[Diamonds as an investment|diamond market]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Ten people are confirmed killed as [[Typhoon Bualoi (2025)|Typhoon Bualoi]] makes landfall in [[Visayas]] and southern [[Luzon]] in the [[Philippines]] since yesterday. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2116095/7-fatalities-reported-in-biliran-bringing-opong-death-toll-to-10 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/least-three-dead-tropical-storm-bualoi-sweeps-through-philippines-2025-09-26/ (Reuters)]

*At least 14 people are killed when a minibus collides with two trucks in the southern [[Peruvian Andes]], [[Peru]]. [https://apnews.com/video/bus-crash-in-peru-kills-at-least-14-people-8c0011a90f514ad9ada7de1a4f11b4be (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed and 33 are injured when a [[building collapse]]s following a fire in [[Nile Delta]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fire-textile-dye-business-gharbia-nile-delta-firefighters-2806f2c58e632ee2b933791bce1e5010 (AP)]
*At least eleven people are killed and three others are injured after a truck crashes in [[Dera Ismail Khan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1944745/at-least-11-dead-3-wounded-as-truck-crashes-in-kps-di-khan-rescue-1122 (''Dawn'')]
*Six people are killed and six others are injured when a roof collapses at a steel plant in [[Raipur]], [[Chhattisgarh]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/6-dead-6-injured-as-roof-of-structure-in-chhattisgarh-steel-plant-collapses-cops-9350709 (NDTV)]
*A fire at a [[South Korea]]n [[Government of South Korea|government]] [[data center]] in [[Daejeon]] disrupts more than 600 [[e-government]] systems after an explosion in a [[lithium-ion battery]] triggered the blaze. [https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/east-asia/south-korea-state-data-centre-fire-daejeon-b2834847.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Colombia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] revokes [[Colombia]]n [[President of Colombia|president]] [[Gustavo Petro]]'s [[Visa policy of the United States|visa]] following his participation in a [[pro-Palestinian]] demonstration in [[New York City|New York]] and his remarks urging [[U.S. soldiers]] to disobey [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s orders. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/colombian-president-petro-accuses-us-violating-international-law-after-visa-2025-09-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1991 Austin yogurt shop murders]]
**Deceased [[serial killer]] [[Robert Eugene Brashers]] is identified as the [[prime suspect]] in the quadruple homicide at an [[I Can't Believe It's Yogurt!]] shop in [[Austin, Texas|Austin]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/suspect-identified-in-infamous-texas-yogurt-shop-murder-case-48-hours/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 Danish drone incidents]]
**[[Air Base Karup]] in [[Central Denmark Region]], [[Denmark]], is closed due to a [[drone warfare|drone]] sighting above the [[military base]]. [[Cabinet of Denmark|Danish authorities]] describe the incident as part of an ongoing "[[Hybrid warfare|hybrid attack]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3rvzdq93yro (BBC News)]
*[[2025 Department of Justice counterinvestigation into Russian interference in the 2016 election]]
**Former United States [[FBI]] director [[James Comey]] is [[James Comey#Federal indictment|indicted]] by a federal [[Grand juries in the United States|grand jury]] on two charges in a prosecution led by [[Lindsey Halligan]], the [[United States Attorney|U.S. attorney]] for the [[United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia|Eastern District of Virginia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy50ggv35zpo (BBC News)]
*[[Corruption in Lebanon]]
**[[Lebanon|Lebanese]] authorities release former [[Banque du Liban|central bank]] governor [[Riad Salameh]] after he posts [[bail]] of [[United States dollar|US$]]14 million and [[Lebanese pound|LL]] 5 billion ($55,866) while facing ongoing charges of alleged [[financial crime]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanon-release-former-central-bank-governor-salameh-bail-2025-09-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Human rights in Vietnam]]
**[[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese]] activist [[Trịnh Bá Phương]], already serving a 10-year sentence for [[Censorship in Vietnam|anti-state propaganda]], is sentenced to an additional 11 years after being convicted of writing statements against the [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]] while in prison. [https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-communist-dissident-convicted-f45a4b12e68954590510bc8353a95378 (AP)]
*[[LGBTQ rights in Slovakia]]
**[[Slovakia]] passes a [[Constitution of Slovakia|constitution]]al [[Constitution of Slovakia#Amendments|amendment]] stating there are only [[Gender binary|two genders]]. Only [[married couple]]s have the right to [[adopt]], which ''[[de facto]]'' prevents [[same-sex couple]]s from adopting, while also banning [[surrogacy]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/slovakia-two-gender-constitution-male-female/ (Politico)]

*[[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Moldova]]'s [[Central Electoral Commission of Moldova|electoral commission]] removes the [[Greater Moldova Party|Greater Moldova]] and [[Heart of Moldova Party|Heart of Moldova]] [[List of political parties in Moldova|parties]] from the ballot ahead of Sunday's election, citing alleged illegal financing and foreign funding. [https://www.reuters.com/world/moldova-bans-another-pro-russian-party-sundays-vote-2025-09-27/ (Reuters)]
